newsitem.title: USA: Conn. Foxwoods revenues slip in April - paper.
newsitem.headline: Conn. Foxwoods revenues slip in April - paper.

text.p: Revenues from the Mashantucket Pequots' Foxwoods Resort Casino in Connecticut slipped to $46.7 million in April from $48 million in March, the Hartford Courant reported Wednesday.
The tribe's contribution to the state for April was $11.7 million, raising its total for the fiscal year to $77.8 million.
State officials estimate that they will get about $200 million this year from Foxwoods and the Mohegan Sun casino, which pay 25 percent of slot revenue to the state government, the paper added.
